defect: write-side and read-side warm-reset ordering is unspecified
rationale: The FIFO state and its synchronized history are reset independently; without a contract describing whether a warm reset may occur with an item outstanding, the post-reset interpretation of the crossing state is undecidable.

mutation.description: Reduced the source FIFO to one crossing item with independent write and read reset controls.

provenance.adaptation: Removed depth and frame features while retaining independently reset write/read state and pointer history.

labels.note: Toggle-handshake state is reset by two independent async resets; resetting one side alone leaves the toggles unequal and creates a phantom or lost transfer, and no sequencing contract is stated.
